title: System of Equations
statementMd:
Furik loves math lessons very much, so he doesn't attend them, unlike Rubik. But now Furik wants to get a good mark for math. For that Ms. Ivanova, his math teacher, gave him a new task. Furik solved the task immediately. Can you?

You are given a system of equations:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/48f8e87e7de463d866e8659e7b0f849f99b5e53b.png)

You should count, how many there are pairs of integers $(*a*, *b*)$ $(0 ≤ *a*, *b*)$ which satisfy the system.

## Input

A single line contains two integers $*n*, *m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1000)$ — the parameters of the system. The numbers on the line are separated by a space.

## Output

On a single line print the answer to the problem.

## Note

In the first sample the suitable pair is integers $(3, 0)$. In the second sample the suitable pair is integers $(3, 5)$. In the third sample there is no suitable pair.
statementZhMd:
Furik 非常喜欢数学课，所以他不像 Rubik 那样去上课。不过现在 Furik 想在数学课上取得好成绩。为此，他的数学老师 Ivanova 女士给了他一道新题。Furik 立刻解决了这道题。你能做到吗？

给定一个方程组：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/48f8e87e7de463d866e8659e7b0f849f99b5e53b.png)

请你计算有多少对整数 $(*a*, *b*)$ $(0 ≤ *a*, *b*)$ 满足该方程组。

## 输入格式

一行包含两个整数 $*n*, *m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1000)$，表示方程组的参数。该行中的数字以空格分隔。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出题目的答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，符合条件的整数对为 $(3, 0)$。在第二个样例中，符合条件的整数对为 $(3, 5)$。在第三个样例中不存在符合条件的整数对。
